title: Verify project prerequisites and setup dependencies
description: Verify Next.js 16 environment, check .env.local placeholder values for Supabase and Cloudflare R2, and install required UI dependencies (lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-accordion).
acceptanceCriteria: .env.local exists with Supabase and Cloudflare R2 environment variable placeholders
npm dependencies for lucide-react and Radix UI primitives are cleanly installed without SIGILL crashes
Next.js build or dev server starts cleanly on port 3000
Playwright test runner configuration is verified

steps.details: Verify NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and Cloudflare R2 configurations exist in .env.local.
Install lucide-react and essential Radix UI primitives (dialog, accordion, tooltip) needed for the navigation and customizer.

steps.description: Verify build and dev server sanity
steps.details: Run `npm run build` or start dev server to confirm Next.js 16 and Tailwind v4 compile without errors.
